testCases.title: Grant path: request team access, manager approves
testCases.workflow: UAM Initiate User Team Access / UAM User Team Request Access Approval

preconditions.state: User TU-004 does not have access to 'Test Team Gamma'

steps: Request access to team 'Test Team Gamma' in 'Test Org Alpha'
Confirm a Task Request is created with taskStatusId=1 (In progress), taskDefinitionId=1 (Add Approval)
Log in as TU-003 (the team manager)
Open Manager Tasks, open the request, click Approve
expectedResults: Task Request created In progress and the team manager is emailed
On approve: a UAM User Team row is granted for TU-004 + application roles; taskStatusId=2 (Approved); requester emailed
Event history logs the submit and approve events
cleanup: Revoke the granted User Team access; soft-delete the Task Request

testCases.title: Reject path: manager rejects with a reason
testCases.workflow: UAM User Team Request Access Approval

preconditions.state: An In progress access request exists for a team TU-003 manages

steps: Open Manager Tasks, open the request
Click Reject without entering a reason (expect validation)
expectedResults: Reject is blocked until a reason is entered
On reject: taskStatusId=3 (Rejected), reasonForRejection is stored, requester emailed the reason, no User Team granted
assertions: No UAM User Team row created for the requester

testCases.title: Revoke path: revoke access, manager approves
testCases.workflow: UAM Initiate User Team Revoke / UAM User Team Request Access Revoke

preconditions.state: TU-004 currently has access to 'Test Team Gamma'

steps: Initiate a revoke of TU-004's access to 'Test Team Gamma'
Confirm a Task Request with taskDefinitionId=2 (Revoke Approval) is created
Log in as TU-003, approve the revoke
expectedResults: On approve: TU-004's UAM User Team row is removed; taskStatusId=2; TU-004 emailed
cleanup: Restore access via pre-provisioned data reset if needed

testCases.title: Manager self-service grant (bypass)
testCases.workflow: UAM Self Grant Access By PM

preconditions.state: TU-003 is a manager eligible to self-grant

steps: Use Self Grant Access on a team TU-003 manages
expectedResults: Access is granted without a separate approval task, only when the self-check passes

testCases.title: Cannot request a team already held

preconditions.state: TU-004 already has access to 'Test Team Gamma'

steps: Confirm 'Test Team Gamma' is not selectable / is excluded
expectedResults: Teams already held are excluded from the request picker (UAM_qry_excludeteamsToAlreadyAdd)
assertions: 'Test Team Gamma' is not present in the selectable list
